pistes.name: Varvsbacken
pistes.basis: OSM maps only the drag lift (w260941457, 386 m, x 811 from z -1118 to -732) and no piste. The orthophoto shows one mown alpine corridor around it: 120 m wide at the base station by the E4, narrowing to 30 m at the lift's top, bare rock on its east side at z -1060..-1020. Traced as that corridor; the clearings west of it are felled ground, not piste.
